user-sage.note: User Sage hosted MCP server for AI-assisted user testing: plan studies, draft them, recruit panels, read findings, work with personas and AI panels. Auth is per-user: set USERSAGE_API_KEY in your environment (a User Sage API key from Workspace settings > Integrations > MCP Connector) before starting Grok. Any plan can connect: Free can plan a study and list Briefs; Pro adds creating, running, recruiting, results, Projects, personas and panels. If ${USERSAGE_API_KEY} is not expanded by your Grok client, register the server manually in your own Grok MCP config with the same URL and an Authorization: Bearer header carrying your key. See README.md.
